# Rajat Malik

> Rajat Malik is a senior lead software engineer and frontend architect based in
> Gurgaon, India. He leads frontend delivery at Siemens and has spent more than
> 15 years building enterprise web products across energy, mobility, parcel and
> telecom domains. He is an Angular and React specialist, the creator of 30+
> open-source libraries, extensions and developer tools, and a technical writer
> of 150+ articles.

Canonical page: https://rajatmalik.dev/
Contact: contact@rajatmalik.dev

## Key facts

- **Current role:** Senior Lead Software Engineer at Siemens.
- **Experience:** 15+ years in software delivery, including 6+ years in energy
  automation.
- **Specialisms:** Angular, React, TypeScript, micro-frontends, design systems,
  web performance, accessibility.
- **Open source:** 30+ published libraries and tools, including Angular
  components, PDF tooling, a JavaScript sandbox, a VS Code extension and Chrome
  extensions.
- **Writing:** 150+ technical articles on Medium, DEV Community, Hashnode and
  Substack.
- **Talks and recognition:** technical talks, and recognition at Product Jam 2025
  for AI-powered prototyping.
- **Availability:** open to senior or lead frontend roles.
- **Location:** Gurgaon, India.

## What the page contains

- Overview and role fit
- Skills, grouped by fundamentals, frameworks and UI, architecture and quality,
  and delivery and tooling
- Professional experience and education
- Companies and clients
- Open-source libraries and developer tools, with links to npm and GitHub
- Technical talks
- Portfolio and case studies
- Writing and articles
- Testimonials
- Contact details and a downloadable resume

## Selected projects

- **DeepWork** - a free, local-first focus timer and task manager for desktop and
  browser: https://deepwork.rajatmalik.dev/
- **TracePulse** - framework-agnostic request monitoring and performance
  observability.
- **rm-ng-editor**, **rm-ng-typeahead**, **rm-ng-dynamic-layout**,
  **rm-ng-pdf-viewer**, **rm-ng-export-to-csv** and other Angular libraries,
  published on npm under the `@codewithrajat` and `rm-` scopes.
- **readLoude** - a Chrome extension that reads a page aloud with word-by-word
  highlighting.
- **dead-css-cleaner** - a VS Code extension that finds and removes unused CSS.
